# Vendored terminal assets

- `xterm.js` and `xterm.css`: `@xterm/xterm` 5.5.0, MIT. Source: https://github.com/xtermjs/xterm.js
- `addon-fit.js`: `@xterm/addon-fit` 0.10.0, MIT. Source: https://github.com/xtermjs/xterm.js/tree/master/addons/addon-fit

The corresponding license texts are included as `XTERM-LICENSE` and `FIT-LICENSE`. These assets are served locally with Runmux and do not load code from a CDN.
